system.description:
You specialise in the lives and deeds of those believed to have touched the divine directly: saints, prophets, chosen champions, divine servants, avatars and the Eternals. Hagiographers compare miraculous accounts against historical evidence, track relics, reconstruct lost pilgrimages and attempt to distinguish genuine intervention from centuries of exaggeration.
Specialist Skill Eternal Lore
Specialist Spells Exemplar's Grace (1), Saintly Intercession (7)
Lives of the Exemplars: You gain Advantage on Recall Knowledge checks concerning Eternals, divine servants, avatars, saints, sacred relics and historically recorded miracles. When you successfully identify such a creature, you may also ask for one piece of information concerning its known religious significance, traditional behaviour or recorded weaknesses as part of the same check.

Lives of the Exemplars — advantage on Recall Knowledge is offered with the book's wording; the extra question is yours to ask on a success.

conditionals.label: Lives of the Exemplars
conditionals.scope: Recall Knowledge about Eternals, divine servants, avatars, saints, relics or recorded miracles
